identification: Two boxes of art reference books, about 60 volumes: Great Prints and Printmakers (Herman Wechsler, 1967), Art in the Middle Ages (Pijoan, 1940), English Furniture The Georgian Period 1750-1830 (Jourdain and Rose, Batsford), Degas (Ian Dunlop), Savage Ruskin, Dali by Dali, Leon Underwood, Francis Bacon, Monet at Giverny, Africa39, February House, Robert Hughes The Art of Australia, etc. Estimate 30-50.
